options.name: disk_number
options.description: Used to specify the disk number of the disk to be initialized.

options.name: force
options.description: Specify if initializing should be forced for disks that are already initialized.

options.name: online
options.description: If the disk is offline and/or readonly update the disk to be online and not readonly.

options.name: path
options.description: Used to specify the path to the disk to be initialized.

options.name: style
options.description: The partition style to use for the disk. Valid options are mbr or gpt.

options.name: uniqueid
options.description: Used to specify the uniqueid of the disk to be initialized.
